visual.name: atlasHierarchy
visual.description: Treemap, sunburst, circle packing and org chart / hierarchy tree in one visual, with zoom, flat, soft and 3D looks and a palette that follows your report theme, a brand color or your own colors.

en-US.Role_Levels_Desc: One or more fields from the top level down, for example Category, Subcategory, Product.
en-US.Role_Id_Desc: For an org chart: the field that identifies each person or node (use instead of Levels).
en-US.Role_Parent_Desc: For an org chart: the ID of the manager or parent node. Empty for the top.
en-US.Role_Label_Desc: For an org chart: the name shown on each card (defaults to the ID).
en-US.Role_Values_Desc: The value that sizes tiles, segments and circles.
en-US.Role_Color_Desc: Optional. Colors items on a gradient (for example Margin %) when Color rules › Color by is Color value.
en-US.Landing_Line1: Add one or more fields to Levels (for example Category, Subcategory, Product) and a measure to Size.
en-US.Landing_Line2: For an org chart, use ID and Parent ID instead of Levels. Pick treemap, sunburst, circle packing or org chart in the Format pane.
en-US.Warn_Limit_Text: There is more data than the visual can show. Filter the report to see the rest.
en-US.Mark_Selected: Selected: this visual is filtering other visuals
en-US.Mark_Filter: This visual is filtering the report
en-US.Mark_Highlighted: Highlighted by a selection in another visual
